name: hybrid_reranker
observations: Hybrid retrieval and reranking preserved evidence-page hits for all five answerable questions.
The participant-count answer-bearing chunk moved from vector rank 8 and BM25 rank 14 to reranker rank 1.
The participant-count answer improved from 77 in the vector-only baseline to the correct 85.
The unanswerable medication question triggered an appropriate refusal.
Chunk-level retrieval evaluation currently contains verified ground truth for only one question.
The evaluation set is small and based on a single research paper, so these results should not be generalized as overall system accuracy.
